title: Dominic and the Static
author: Sebastian Kavanagh
blurb: Isandro Coldharbour, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
